# Constance

[![Hasbro Studios — Constance perched on Fluttershy's hoof in Trade Ya!](https://derpicdn.net/img/2022/9/1/2938808/full.png)](https://derpibooru.org/images/2938808)

Constance is Fluttershy's little orange songbird — not a pony. Recognize her by her reddish-orange plumage, darker wing and tail feathers, pale yellow beak and black eyes. She is a recurring member of Fluttershy's bird choir and occasionally acts as her messenger.

- **Name and continuity:** Constance is an official on-screen name, first spoken by Fluttershy in *Flutter Brutter* (2016), not a fandom invention. The bird is identified as female in the [character reference](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Constance); her human-world counterpart is addressed as “Mr. Bird” in *Equestria Girls: Legend of Everfree*, so the two portrayals should not be conflated.
- **Speaking:** Chirps and sings rather than speaking intelligible words to the audience. Fluttershy understands her. No individual voice performer was verified.
- **Appearances:** Debuts in *Friendship Is Magic, Part 1* (S1E1); also appears in *A Canterlot Wedding – Part 2*, *Filli Vanilli*, *Trade Ya!*, *Scare Master*, *Fluttershy Leans In*, *Marks for Effort* and *Best Gift Ever*. The character reference also records a profile in *The Elements of Harmony, Volume II*.

## Important moments

- **Warning Fluttershy about Zephyr — [Flutter Brutter (S6E11), transcript](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?t=64764):** Constance alerts Fluttershy after her brother goes to live in the woods, prompting her to check on him and help him overcome his fear of failure. [Full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Qy194L3Cvpg); scene timestamp unavailable.
- **Discovering animal communication — [Legend of Everfree (2016), transcript](https://www.transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?t=57699):** The human-world bird helps Fluttershy reach paper towels and reveals that she can understand animals, then calls other birds to join them. [Full film on Tubi](https://tubitv.com/movies/100032447/my-little-pony-equestria-girls-legend-of-everfree); scene timestamp unavailable.
